prompt:

Asset type: horizontal editorial cover photograph for a Spanish publication about AI and work
Primary request: an independent tailor repeatedly guiding fabric under a sewing machine, focused on one small repeatable task that could be automated.
Scene/backdrop: a modest neighborhood sewing workshop with fabric rolls and practical tools, no paperwork.
Style/medium: candid documentary photography, authentic hands and textile texture, subtle 35mm film grain.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9 landscape crop, tailor and moving fabric shown in profile, human and close.

Constraints: no readable text, brand marks, watermark.
Avoid: office, documents, paper, computer, visible screens, robots, futuristic effects, generic AI stock-photo clichés.
